ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto prices slipped across the board on Tuesday, with Bitcoin down 2.9% to $76,076 and Ethereum down 3.5% to $2,413, while most altcoins posted modest losses. The decline follows heightened uncertainty around U.S. legislative action on the Clarity Act and mixed signals from European digital‑euro initiatives.
